name: Poland Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Poland Syndrome

criteria.description: Unilateral absence or hypoplasia of the pectoralis major muscle
Ipsilateral upper limb anomalies such as symbrachydactyly or brachydactyly
Presence of rib cage deformities or absence of ribs on the affected side
Ipsilateral breast and nipple hypoplasia or aplasia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of unilateral pectoralis major muscle hypoplasia or absence plus at least one ipsilateral upper limb anomaly
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; imaging may assist in confirming musculoskeletal anomalies.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Unilateral absence or hypoplasia of pectoralis major muscle
Ipsilateral breast and nipple hypoplasia or aplasia

common.symptomName: Rib cage deformities or absence of ribs

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory compromise due to chest wall deformity
Mild functional limitation of upper limb

rare.symptomName: Cardiac anomalies such as ventricular septal defect
Neurological symptoms secondary to thoracic outlet syndrome

imaging: Chest X-ray showing absent or hypoplastic ribs and chest wall deformity
MRI or CT scan confirming absence or hypoplasia of pectoralis major muscle
Ultrasound or MRI of upper limb anomalies
genetic: No consistent genetic mutation identified; mostly sporadic cases
Rare familial cases reported with possible autosomal dominant inheritance with variable expressivity
other: Clinical examination revealing unilateral chest wall and upper limb anomalies

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of constriction rings and distal amputations
Neurovascular compression symptoms without congenital chest wall anomalies
Short neck and limited neck mobility

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress due to chest wall deformity
Associated cardiac or renal anomalies requiring urgent evaluation
references: Fokin AA, Robicsek F. Poland's syndrome revisited. Ann Thorac Surg. 2002;74(6):2218-25.
Al-Qattan MM. Poland syndrome: a clinical review. Ann Plast Surg. 2011;66(6):589-92.
